subject: GCP co-sell pipeline scouting & PM handshake — Stratos Labs listing readiness
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sangeeta Rao <sangeeta@stratosmedical.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@gcp-partners.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP co-sell pipeline scouting & PM handshake — Stratos Labs listing readiness

Hi Sangeeta / Ben —

Thanks again for your time on the call last week. Stratos' telemetry use-case looks promising for a GCP Marketplace listing + co-sell. I'd like to pull together a short mutual action plan and a joint pipeline review with GCP partner PMs to: (1) prioritize 3 target accounts for co-sell outreach, (2) align listing readiness requirements, and (3) confirm next steps for a canary deployment with Stratos.

Proposed agenda (20–30 min):
- Quick intro & roles (2 min)
- Top 3 co-sell candidate accounts (8 min)
- Listing readiness checklist & blockers (8 min)
- Next steps & owner assignments (5 min)

Can we run a joint PM handoff with your GCP partner contact next week? I'm looping Vanessa (partner ops) and Vivek (field) to coordinate capacity and capture capture-priority from our side.

I can draft a one-page mutual action plan and a listing checklist and share before the meeting. What times next week look good for you and Ben?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: none in this message
From: Sangeeta Rao <sangeeta@stratosmedical.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@gcp-partners.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell pipeline scouting & PM handshake — Stratos Labs listing readiness

Marissa —

Great timing. Ben is our technical partner manager for the GCP engagement — looping him in here (cc). We are keen to run a short joint review. The three accounts we'd prioritize are: Mercer Health, Northspan Clinics, and Halcyon Care. Mercer and Northspan are mid-funnel and likely to benefit from a hosted trial; Halcyon needs an on-prem connector conversation first.

Quick asks from our side before the meeting:
- A one-pager mutual action plan (owners + timelines)
- Product listing checklist so our compliance & procurement teams can do a quick pass

Ben — can you confirm availability for next Tue/Wed afternoon PST?

Thanks,
Sangeeta Rao
Director, Strategic Partnerships — Stratos Medical
sangeeta@stratosmedical.com
